spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:26:7: command demo: flag "day": `default` "+2h" is not a valid date (a date moves in whole days, such as 1d or 2w); every run that leaves it unset would fail
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:14:7: command demo: flag "count": sets `relative` but its type is int; a relative value is a time measured from now, so it applies to time, datetime and date
